note_sections.t: Re-evaluation for prior prostate cancer diagnosis to determine optimal management strategy.

Recently retired butcher with a history of upper abdominal surgery. Patient lives alone and is widowed, with spouse as primary next-of-kin. Alcohol intake is 3 units/week, and he walks 45 minutes daily. PSA trend shows steady rise from 1.6 ng/mL in Jan 2024 to 4.7 ng/mL in Jan 2025. IPSS score is 12/35, indicating moderate LUTS. Memory clinic screening and routine chest X-ray were recent unrelated appointments. No current medications or allergies reported.
On DRE, the prostate is enlarged with an abnormal texture, consistent with cT1c staging. General examination shows stable vital signs and no acute distress.
